1.title: Lentejas con arroz y cebolla dorada
1.dish: a small white enamel pot of brown lentil stew with rice and golden fried onion, steam rising, a wooden spoon in it
1.truco: Agua caliente, nunca fría, si espesa.

2.title: Sopa de pan duro y huevo
2.dish: a deep bowl of garlic bread soup with a poached egg floating in it and chopped parsley, torn pieces of stale bread
2.truco: Un huevo al final, tapa dos minutos.

3.title: Arroz con salchicha y guisantes
3.dish: a pot of yellow rice with sliced sausage rounds and green peas, steam, a wooden spoon
3.truco: No destapes: el vapor lo deja suelto.

4.title: Puré de papa con huevo duro
4.dish: a plate of mashed potatoes with chopped hard boiled egg and golden fried onion on top, a fork
4.truco: Una sola agua para papas y huevo.

5.title: Estofado de garbanzos con papa
5.dish: a pot of chickpea and potato stew with orange paprika broth, tomato, a wooden spoon pressing a chickpea against the side
5.truco: Aplasta garbanzos: el caldo espesa solo.

6.title: Sopa de fideos finos con verduras
6.dish: a bowl of thin noodle soup with tiny diced carrot and celery in clear broth, steam

7.title: Frijoles de olla con arroz
7.dish: a clay-brown pot of black beans with a bay leaf next to a bowl of white rice, steam

8.title: Polenta cremosa con queso
8.dish: a deep plate of creamy yellow cornmeal polenta with melting grated cheese in a spoon-made hollow

9.title: Guiso de calabaza y maíz
9.dish: a small pot of orange pumpkin stew with corn kernels and tomato, steam, a wooden spoon
9.truco: Aplasta calabaza: queda cremoso sin nata.

10.title: Sopa de papa y puerro
10.dish: a bowl of pale potato leek soup with a swirl of milk, a slice of bread beside it
10.truco: Machaca la mitad con un tenedor.

11.title: Arroz caldoso de pollo
11.dish: a pot of soupy rice with shredded chicken and carrot, steam rising

12.title: Tallarines con ajo y aceite
12.dish: a pot of spaghetti tossed with golden garlic slices and olive oil, parsley, a fork twirling it
12.truco: Guarda un cucharón de agua de la pasta.

13.title: Guiso de lentejas con chorizo
13.dish: a pot of lentil stew with red chorizo slices, potato and carrot, steam

14.title: Sopa de tomate con pan tostado
14.dish: a bowl of red tomato soup with toasted bread cubes floating, a spoon
14.truco: Una pizca de azúcar si sale ácida.

15.title: Revuelto de papa y cebolla
15.dish: a pan of thin potato slices and onion mixed with soft scrambled egg, golden
15.truco: Si no se da la vuelta, es revuelto.

16.title: Arroz amarillo con huevo
16.dish: a plate of yellow turmeric rice with a fried egg with a soft yolk on top
16.truco: Dos cosas de despensa y una cena.

17.title: Sopa de verduras de las sobras
17.dish: a pot of mixed vegetable soup with carrot ends, celery leaves and potato, a ladle, a cutting board with vegetable scraps beside it
17.truco: Nunca se repite: nunca sobra lo mismo.

18.title: Fideos con atún y tomate
18.dish: a plate of short pasta with tuna and tomato sauce, an open tin of tuna beside it
18.truco: La otra mitad de la lata, en frasco.

19.title: Guiso de arroz, calabaza y frijol
19.dish: a pot of thick rice stew with pumpkin cubes and beans, steam

20.title: Caldo de hueso con fideos
20.dish: a bowl of golden beef bone broth with thin noodles and shredded meat, a soup bone in the pot behind

21.title: Migas de pan con ajo y pimentón
21.dish: a pan of golden breadcrumbs with garlic and paprika, a fried egg on top, stale bread beside
21.truco: El pan duro nunca se tira.

22.title: Sopa de maíz y queso
22.dish: a creamy yellow corn soup with grated cheese in a bowl, a corn cob on the table

23.title: Pasta con papa y ajo
23.dish: a pot of short pasta cooked with small potato cubes and garlic, creamy

24.title: Cazuela de arroz con verduras
24.dish: a colorful pot of rice with diced carrot, green beans and tomato
24.truco: Un puñado de queso al final.

25.title: Frijoles refritos con huevo
25.dish: a plate of mashed refried beans with a fried egg on top and a corn tortilla beside it
25.truco: Guarda el caldo de los frijoles.

26.title: Sopa de cebolla con pan y queso
26.dish: a brown ceramic bowl of dark onion soup with a toasted bread slice and melted cheese on top

27.title: Guiso de papa y huevo
27.dish: a pot of potato stew with tomato and two eggs cracked on top, steam
27.truco: Un huevo por persona y nada más.

28.title: Arroz con leche en una sola olla
28.dish: a bowl of creamy rice pudding dusted with cinnamon, a lemon peel, a cup of tea beside it

29.title: Sopa de calabaza cremosa
29.dish: a bowl of smooth orange pumpkin soup with a swirl of milk and a pinch of nutmeg
29.truco: Un chorrito de leche al final.

30.title: Puchero de domingo para uno
30.dish: a pot of boiled beef with potato, carrot, cabbage wedge and a piece of corn on the cob, broth in a deep plate
30.truco: De una olla salen tres comidas.

reglas.text: Tres reglas de la olla pequeña
